forgeImplementation.dataBoundary: All PRs, file contents, commits, CI status and linked issue options are fictional. User edits, comments, favorites, review decisions and reviewed markers persist in browser storage scoped to workspace and user. No review operation sends an external request. The agent button opens the existing composer without sending a message.
